description: This Python source file defines a class 'LangchainPDFProcessor' that processes PDF files using Langchain's PyMuPDFLoader. It includes methods for initializing a text splitter, processing PDFs to extract and split text into chunks, and logging the process.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: A class to process PDF files by loading, splitting, and formatting text chunks using Langchain tools.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PDF processor with a text splitter configured with chunk size and overlap.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Loads a PDF file, splits it into text chunks, and returns a list of formatted chunks with metadata.
